description_en: Queries the real-time status of a mobile phone number to determine whether it is in service, suspended, or non-existent. This operation supports queries for plaintext numbers or numbers encrypted with MD5 or SHA256
description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi phone-number-status-for-public --auth-code Dd1r0004id --input-number 13900001234 --mask NORMAL --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PhoneNumberStatusForPublic

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page of the Phone Number Intelligence console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), you can obtain the authorization ID and use it as the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

If `Mask` is set to `NORMAL`, this parameter must be an 11-digit mobile phone number.

If `Mask` is set to `MD5`, this parameter must be a 32-character encrypted string.

If `Mask` is set to `SHA256`, this parameter must be a 64-character encrypted string.

If `Mask` is set to `SM3`, this parameter must be a 64-character encrypted string.

The encrypted strings are case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SM3，该字段为64位加密字符串。

加密字符串中字母不区分大小写
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

NORMAL: The phone number is not encrypted.

MD5

SHA256

SM3
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密

MD5

SHA256

SM3
parameters.name: mask
